title: Lovely Spicy Brazilian Kabocha Grill
description: A spicy and sweet Brazilian dish featuring kabocha, perfect for a hangover cure, made with sugar-free friendly ingredients and grilled to perfection
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, lime juice, garlic, ginger paste, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the cubed kabocha squash to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the kabocha squash onto skewers, if desired, and grill for 20-25 minutes, turning occasionally.
Grill the kabocha squash until it is tender and lightly charred.
Remove the kabocha squash from the grill and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Serve the lovely spicy Brazilian kabocha grill hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
